## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` 的 `os package publish` 一行加了一句，指向 Marketplace handbook（`/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook`）：listing 文件、README、审核、以及客户管理员会经过的每个界面。为付 token 棘轮，删掉了同文件 cloud-connection 引文块的尾巴（`LocalManifestSource` 账本、runtime-identity bind v2），那是插件内部机制，应用作者不碰。
- 为什么改：写应用的 agent 先读 skills；没有这一句，它永远找不到那页，发布时不知道 listing 由什么组成、审核查什么、客户管理员装进去会经过什么（北极星第④步）。PR #27321 落地 handbook 时刻意没碰受管面，欠下这一句。
- 风险与回滚：只动一个 markdown 文件、两处文字，附 @objectstack/skills patch changeset；无代码、无 spec。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` 第 106 行（新句与链接），第 109–114 行（删掉的引文块尾巴）。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期该文件 `3124 tokens (ceiling 3125; headroom 1)`，全绿。
- 需要你做的：Tier H（`skills/**`），本 PR 保持 draft，需要你批准后由席位落地。附：卡上的 rider（`openapi` `include` 两行）在 PR #28012 已改好，本 PR 不再动它，见 Acceptance notes。

## What changes

One file, `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md`, two hunks:

1. **The `os package publish` row** (Environments & deploy table) gains one sentence: "Listing file, README, review and every screen the customer's administrator meets: [Marketplace handbook](https://objectstack.ai/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook)". This is the reference file where an app-authoring agent reads about `os package publish` (the card allows the reference file in place of `SKILL.md`; `SKILL.md` names the `marketplace` service token once and nothing about publishing). The link form matches the four existing docs links in `skills/**`, all `https://objectstack.ai/docs/...`. The page is on `main` and listed in `content/docs/deployment/meta.json`.
   - **Reader:** the app-authoring agent at the moment it runs `os package publish`.
   - **Mistake it prevents:** publishing with no listing file or README (the publish answers with marketplace policy violations), and shipping an app with no idea what review checks or what the customer's administrator goes through (credentials, sample data, enable/disable, upgrade).
2. **Paid for under the skills token ratchet** by deleting, in the same file, the tail of the cloud-connection blockquote: ", and maintain `LocalManifestSource` (a local desired-state ledger) plus runtime-identity bind v2 (environment-less self-hosted binding)". Those are plugin internals an app author never acts on; their home is the plugin's own source (`packages/cloud-connection/src/connection-credential-store.ts` names the `LocalManifestSource` ledger and the runtime-identity-binding ADR; `cloud-connection-plugin.ts` carries the binding). What the blockquote still teaches (the package, its plugins, the install-local endpoint `os package install` targets, the Installed Apps page and Setup nav) is unchanged. No re-wrap: the two hunks are a content addition and a content deletion.

## Why

The card: a follow-up PR #27321 owed when it landed the handbook and deliberately left the governed `skills/**` line out. The agent that writes an app reads the skills first; without this line it never finds the page that says what a listing is made of and what the customer's administrator will go through, North Star step ④.

## Acceptance notes

- **The rider on the card (the `openapi` `include` lines) is already delivered on `main`, so this PR does not touch the two automation files the claim's file surface lists.** The epic PM's request 6488631558 asked that, once PR #27387 merged, `skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md` line 63 ("The `openapi` provider has no `include` key — the trimmed document is the allowlist.") and case 1's `expected_output` in `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/integrations-declared.json` be rewritten in the same skills PR. Read at `origin/main` 5da3a8ce on 2026-10-31, both already teach `include`: the recipe reads "`providerConfig.include` allowlists operation keys as the `mcp` provider's does (absent = every operation; a non-array or unknown entry is fatal)", and the eval reads "(or `providerConfig.include` names those three operation keys, the `mcp` provider's allowlist meaning, where a non-array or unknown entry is fatal)". The commit list for both files names PR #28012 (merged 2026-10-30, "docs(skills): teach connector_action input as an evaluated value slot and the openapi include allowlist") as the change, and its body says in so many words that items 3, 4 and 5 are those two lines. Measured against `packages/connectors/connector-openapi/src/openapi-provider.ts` on `main` (`resolveIncludeList`: absent returns undefined, a non-array or a non-string or empty entry throws; an entry the document does not carry is refused after generation), the published text is exact. Nothing to change; the token ratchet shows `integration-recipes.md` at headroom 0, so a re-touch would have cost a deletion for no gain.
- **Governed surface.** `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/project-thread-ce0xlt`, exit 3: "derived from `git diff --name-only --no-renames 5da3a8ce31 1212152e32` (three-dot): 1 path(s). governed-surface predicate: 1 of 1 path(s) hit the register (13 surfaces govern objectstack). ⛔ GOVERNED — a human merge is the review record for this PR. landing tier: H(人合). skills/** ×1 — the published skills catalog: skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md. size: 6 changed line(s) (+2 / -4) ≤ 3000". The PR stays draft for the maintainer's approval; no seat readies, queues or arms it.
- **Changeset:** the change ships in `@objectstack/skills` (`dist/skills` via `sync-catalog.mjs`, and `dist` is in its `files[]`), so `.changeset/27331-skills-marketplace-handbook-link.md` carries a patch bump with the two declaration lines; no `skip-changeset` label (the one sent on the `pr_create` was removed).
- **`pnpm lint` scoped to touched packages:** no package is touched (the diff is one markdown file under `skills/`, which eslint does not lint), so there is no scoped lint run to cite; `pnpm lint` repo-wide belongs to CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`.
- Nothing else found; no cards to file.
